## Git Clone
 - A panel next to the editor: paste a repository URL and tap **Clone**
 - Real Git clone with JGit, running inside the app — live progress bar and phase label
 - Material 3 filter chips: Submodules, Shallow, Single branch, No tags, Bare repository
 - Optional branch name for a single-branch / pinned clone
 - Optional access token for private HTTPS remotes
 - Target folder is derived from the project root when left empty
 - Smooth animated progress and a colour-coded output log
 - Colours come from the IDE theme through `M3Theme`, so it follows light/dark and every colour scheme
 - Built with Material 3 (ChipGroup + LinearProgressIndicator) for a light, fast layout
